scripts.title: Flux Universal
scripts.features:
A universal Roblox exploit script that provides a mod menu GUI with cheat features for any Roblox game. It detects which executor is running it and loads the appropriate version.

Two Versions
PC Version — for executors like Volt, Potassium, Wave, Madium, Real, Isaeva, Cosmic, Velocity, SirHurt, Solara, Xeno

Mobile Version — for Delta and Codex on Android/iOS

Player Tab
WalkSpeed — adjustable slider (16–300) with toggle

JumpPower — adjustable slider (50–300) with toggle

Health — set max health up to 1000 with toggle

TP Tool — gives a FluxTPTool you equip and click to teleport to where you're pointing; can also be removed

XRay — makes walls/environment transparent with batched processing and live updates for newly added parts

Noclip — walk through walls (toggle + N keybind on PC)

Infinite Jump — jump repeatedly in mid-air (PC: Space key; Mobile: dedicated jump button)

Fullbright — enhanced lighting (brightness, no shadows, no fog, exposure, color shifts)

Anti AFK — prevents idle kick

Hitbox Expander — enlarges player hitboxes for easier hits, with adjustable size (2–50 studs), transparency slider (0–1), and an "Ignore Team" option

FPS Cap — limit or uncap framerate with slider (1–9999) and presets: 60, 120, 144, 240, 360, Unlimited

Player Debug — live labels for position, velocity, FPS, uptime, player count; buttons to copy Game ID, Server ID, Position, and a Rejoin Script

Teleport to Subplaces — save custom Place IDs with names, one-click join buttons, add/clear entries, and persistent JSON storage

ESP Tab (Extra Sensory Perception)
Player highlight, names, tracers, skeleton, boxes, health bars, distance

Custom HEX color pickers for each element (saved to FluxUniversal_Colors.json)

Works with both R6 and R15 rigs

Skeleton drawing supports R15 full-body connections and R6 simplified connections

Health bar color shifts based on health percentage

Aimbot Tab
Aimbot:

Lock camera onto nearest player (right-click on PC, toggle on mobile)

Aim Part selector (Head / Torso)

Smoothness slider

FOV circle with adjustable size and custom HEX color

Velocity prediction with adjustable multiplier

Auto-read projectile speed from weapon NumberValues, with fallback speed slider

Humanization with adjustable intensity

Team filter, visibility check

Show/hide FOV circle

Triggerbot:

Auto-fire when crosshair is on target

Adjustable trigger delay, angle threshold, click hold duration, and weapon fire cooldown

Require Weapon toggle

Team filter and visibility check apply

Troll Tab
Touch Fling — launch players on contact

Invisibility — hides your character using a seat anchor method

Orbit Player — continuously circle around a chosen target player at adjustable speed and distance (type the player's name to lock on, with a refresh button)

Headsit Player — sit on a chosen player's head (type the player's name, with refresh button; jump to stop)

Spin — spin your character using AlignOrientation (visible to others) with adjustable speed

Teleport to Player — toggle to continuously teleport to a chosen player, "TP Once" instant button, adjustable offset, with refresh button

Interact Tab (Mobile Version)
TAP TO INTERACT button — fire all nearby ProximityPrompts instantly

Auto Interact — repeatedly triggers prompts within radius (0.3s interval)

Instant Interact — fires prompts the moment they appear

Interact Radius slider (5–100 studs)

Floating draggable INTERACT button on mobile

PC users press E to interact

    local sounds = {}
    for _, v in ipairs(soundService:GetChildren()) do
        if v:IsA("Sound") then
            table.insert(sounds, v)
        end
    end
    
    if #sounds == 0 then
        local none = Instance.new("TextLabel", listFrame)
        none.Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 30)
        none.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        none.Text = "No sounds in SoundService"
        none.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(140, 140, 140)
        none.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
        none.TextSize = 10
        return
    end

            sound:Play()
            status.Text = "Played: " .. sound.Name
            status.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(100, 255, 100)

                    status.Text = "Ready"
                    status.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(140, 140, 140)
                end
            end)
        end)
    end
    
    listFrame.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, #sounds * 31)
    status.Text = "Loaded: " .. #sounds .. " sounds"
    status.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(140, 140, 140)
end

end)

		return
	end

	local delta = input.Position - resizeStart

	local newWidth = math.clamp(
		resizeStartSize.X + delta.X,
		220,
		600
	)

	local newHeight = math.clamp(
		resizeStartSize.Y + delta.Y,
		150,
		500
	)

	frame.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(newWidth, newHeight)

local function findTarget(input)
	input = input:lower():gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")

	if input == "" then
		return nil
	end

	local exactMatch = nil
	local partialMatch = nil

	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		local username = player.Name:lower()

		if username == input then
			exactMatch = player
			break
		end

		if username:sub(1, #input) == input then
			if partialMatch then
				return nil, "Multiple matches"
			end

			partialMatch = player
		end
	end

	return exactMatch or partialMatch
end

local function updateTarget()
	local player, errorMessage = findTarget(targetBox.Text)

	if player then
		targetPlayer = player
		status.Text = "Target: " .. player.Name
		status.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(100, 255, 140)
	elseif errorMessage == "Multiple matches" then
		targetPlayer = nil
		status.Text = "Target: Multiple matches"
		status.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 80)
	else
		targetPlayer = nil
		status.Text = "Target: Not found"
		status.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 100)
	end
end

		return

	if not targetPlayer then
		return
	end

	toggle.Text = "STOP"
	toggle.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 60, 60)
end)
TextChatService.MessageReceived:Connect(function(message)
	if not enabled then
		return
	end

	if not targetPlayer then
		return
	end

	local textSource = message.TextSource

	if not textSource then
		return
	end

	if textSource.UserId == LocalPlayer.UserId then
		return
	end

	if textSource.UserId ~= targetPlayer.UserId then
		return
	end

	if message.Text == "" then
		return
	end

	if message.Text == lastRepeatedMessage then
		return
	end

	lastRepeatedMessage = message.Text

	local generalChannel = TextChatService.TextChannels:FindFirstChild("RBXGeneral")

	if generalChannel then
		generalChannel:SendAsync(message.Text)
	end
end)
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	if targetPlayer == player then
		targetPlayer = nil
		enabled = false

		status.Text = "Target left"
		status.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 100)

		toggle.Text = "START"
		toggle.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(60, 60, 70)
	end
end)

player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()

	wallButton.Text = "Walk on Wall (Locked)"

-- Services
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local CoreGui = game:GetService("CoreGui")

-- Variables
local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local mouse = player:GetMouse()
local selectedInstance = nil
local isSelecting = false
local connection = nil

-- UI Setup
local ScreenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
ScreenGui.Name = "InstanceLoggerUI"

-- Fallback to PlayerGui if CoreGui is restricted

if not success then ScreenGui.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui") end

-- Utility Functions
local function getFullPath(instance)
    local path = instance.Name
    if string.match(path, "[^%w_]") then path = '["' .. path .. '"]' end
    
    local current = instance.Parent
    while current and current ~= game do
        local name = current.Name
        if string.match(name, "[^%w_]") then
            path = '["' .. name .. '"].' .. path
        else
            path = name .. "." .. path
        end
        current = current.Parent
    end
    return "game." .. path
end

local function generateLog(instance)
    local path = getFullPath(instance)
    local parentName = instance.Parent and instance.Parent.Name or "None"
    
    local logData = string.format(
        "Name: %s\n" ..
        "ClassName: %s\n" ..
        "Parent: %s\n" ..
        "Archivable: %s\n" ..
        "-----------------------\n" ..
        "Path:\n%s",
        instance.Name,
        instance.ClassName,
        parentName,
        tostring(instance.Archivable),
        path
    )
    return logData
end

-- Interactions
ToggleButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    isSelecting = not isSelecting
    if isSelecting then
        ToggleButton.Text = "Mode: ON"
        ToggleButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50, 200, 50)
        LogBox.Text = "Left-click on any part in the game to log it."
        
        connection = mouse.Button1Down:Connect(function()
            local target = mouse.Target
            if target then
                selectedInstance = target
                HighlightBox.Adornee = target
                LogBox.Text = generateLog(target)
            end
        end)
    else
        ToggleButton.Text = "Mode: OFF"
        ToggleButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 50, 50)
        HighlightBox.Adornee = nil
        if connection then
            connection:Disconnect()
            connection = nil
        end
    end
end)

CopyButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    if selectedInstance and LogBox.Text ~= "" then
        -- setclipboard is a standard function in almost all executors
        if setclipboard then
            setclipboard(LogBox.Text)
            local oldText = CopyButton.Text
            CopyButton.Text = "Copied!"
            task.wait(1.5)
            CopyButton.Text = oldText
        else
            warn("Your executor does not support setclipboard()")
            CopyButton.Text = "Error: No Clipboard Func"
            task.wait(1.5)
            CopyButton.Text = "Copy to Clipboard"
        end
    end
end)
